moldea maintains durable, Git-owned project context so coding agents can understand a repository consistently over time. It can define canonical project knowledge, agent systems, and relationships between that knowledge and code paths—without taking over unrelated engineering work.

Initialize moldea only when you explicitly want the current repository to adopt it, ideally when the repository already provides enough evidence to describe:

- What the project does
- Who or what it serves
- Any important project constraints

Initialization creates the minimal adoption foundation: `/moldea/moldea.yaml`, `/moldea/project.md`, and a managed awareness block in the README, then validates it.

Don’t initialize it merely because the skill is installed, for a one-off task, or when the project’s purpose is still materially unclear. In that case, clarify the missing project facts first.

Source: [moldea skill guidance](/mnt/.agents/skills/moldea/SKILL.md)
